## 1. The rules underneath

Indirect costs are paid at the negotiated indirect cost rate, which agencies accept [2]. The registry is the first gate [1]. Both rules bear on every award, so the gate and the rate come first. <!-- synthesis --> A later sentence keeps its own place [1].
